title:
Transform for enabling or disabling 3D model link/unlink actions in the
`Reliability.AssetConfig3DModelsGridTable`.

Behavior:
- If no rows are selected, returns an empty action list.
- Enables `LINK_3DMODEL` action when any row is selected.
- Enables `UNLINK_3DMODEL` action **only** if the asset or asset class is already linked.

The `linked` status is determined by inspecting the `assetLinkStatus` and `assetClassLinkStatus`
fields in the selected row data.
name: AssetConfig3DModelsGridTableActionTransform
